title: 第816章 一言不发自杀而亡的决心第815章 赔偿之法袭击还在持续
content_zh:
灰袍人左手下压，短刃的刃口与刀身侧面贴合，将这一刀的轨迹偏转了约两指宽度，同时右手黑刃沿着刀身表面向上滑动，直刺令狐黎的肩胛关节。
令狐黎侧肩避开，黑刃擦过衣袍边缘，在走廊舱壁上留下一道细长的划痕。
他收刀后撤一步，重新调整刀势，刀身横在身前，刀尖略微抬高，“你打不过我你信不信？”
灰袍人不语，继续向前逼近，双刃在身前交替划出，左手短刃切向令狐黎的咽喉方向，右手黑刃从下方刺向腰腹。
两道攻击先后抵达，中间几乎没有留出任何可被利用的空隙。
令狐黎将刀身向右偏转，刀脊抵住短刃的路径，同时刀杆顺势下沉，格开黑刃的刺击。
两刃先后接触刀身表面，发出两道连续的撞击声。
令狐黎的手腕在第二次撞击中感到明显的振动，灰袍人的力道正随着连续攻击的持续而逐渐提升。
令狐黎在刀势被压向侧下方时没有强行抬起刀身。他顺着对方的力道转向，刀身向下沉入几乎贴着地面的位置，然后借着刀身自身的弯曲弹力向上弹起。
《苍梧泪竹湘刀诀》——【斑痕衔泪淬青锋】。
刀身弹起的轨迹恰好卡在灰袍人下一次攻击的发力间隙中，刀锋从他双刃之间切过，在他的袖口边缘留下一道划痕，刀锋穿过时带起的风压沿着走廊侧壁向前推进了一小段距离。
灰袍人向后退了数步，低头看了一眼袖口那道正在渗血的口子，重新抬起双刃，调整了站姿。
他保持着现有的距离，正在重新估算这次攻势需要采用的方向和次序，等待下一次破绽的出现，同时也寻找那些转角处的支撑点，以便在必要时能够改变自己的移动方向。
令狐黎没有给他这个时间。他向前迈出两步，刀身再次扬起，刀光划出的弧线与走廊顶部的灯带边缘短暂重合。
《苍梧泪竹湘刀诀》——【潮卷洞庭刃生寒】！
刀身掠过时，空气的温度在刀锋经过的路径上发生了短暂的降低，舱壁表面的水汽凝结成一层极薄的霜，覆盖了刀锋划过的区域。
灰袍人侧身让过这一刀的轨迹，但刀锋的余势带动起的气流依然刮到了他握着黑刃的手背。
手背上留下了一道极浅的白痕，没有出血，但边缘微微泛红。
令狐黎收力了。
但他的刀势在这一次挥出后没有完全收回。他在刀身即将抵达轨迹终点的位置提前折返，刀锋逆着刚才的方向回扫，在空气中留下了一条交叉的弧线。

《苍梧泪竹湘刀诀》——【万竹摇影碎江风】！
刀光在走廊中形成了两道叠加的弧线，将灰袍人可移动的方向压缩到了更小的范围。
灰袍人被迫后撤了一步，双刃在身前快速交错，试图在两道刀光的交界处找到可以切入的空隙，刀刃与刀身连续碰撞了三次，每一次接触都在刀身上留下新的碰撞点。
灰袍人的身形在第三次碰撞后被震退了一步，撞在身后的舱壁上。
他的双刃还握在手中，但握持的位置比之前靠后了两寸，受力点已经超过了预先设定的收束范围。
他的呼吸变重了，肩胛骨位置的伤口还在渗血，沿着衣袍边缘缓慢向下流淌，在灯带的暖黄色光线中显出一道渐变的暗色色带。
content_en:
The man in gray robe pressed down with his left hand, and the edge of the short blade fitted the side of the blade, deflecting the trajectory of the knife by about two finger widths. At the same time, the black blade of his right hand slid upward along the surface of the blade, stabbing straight into Linghu Li's shoulder joint.
Linghu Li sidestepped, and the black blade grazed the edge of his robe, leaving a long and thin scratch on the corridor bulkhead.
He put away the knife and took a step back, readjusted the sword's strength, placed the blade horizontally in front of him, and raised the tip slightly, "Do you believe you can't beat me?"
The man in gray robe remained silent and continued to approach forward, alternately slashing his two blades in front of him. The short blade of his left hand cut towards Linghu Li's throat, and the black blade of his right hand stabbed his waist and abdomen from below.
The two attacks arrived one after another, leaving almost no exploitable gap in between.
Linghu Li deflected the blade to the right, with the spine of the blade touching the path of the short blade. At the same time, the blade of the blade sank downwards, blocking the black blade's thrust.
The two blades contacted the surface of the blade one after another, making two consecutive impact sounds.
Linghu Li's wrist felt obvious vibrations from the second impact, and the gray-robed man's strength was gradually increasing as the continuous attacks continued.
Linghu Li did not forcibly lift the blade when the blade was pressed to the side and downwards. He turned along with the opponent's force, the blade sank down to a position almost touching the ground, and then bounced up by the bending elasticity of the blade itself.
"Cangwu Tears of Bamboo Xiang Dao Jue" - [Banhen holding tears in his hands to temper the green edge].
The bounce trajectory of the blade happened to be caught in the gap between the gray robe man's next attack. The blade cut between his two blades, leaving a scratch on the edge of his cuffs. The wind pressure caused by the blade passing through pushed forward along the side wall of the corridor for a short distance.
The man in gray robe took a few steps back, looked down at the bleeding hole on his sleeves, raised his two blades again, and adjusted his stance.
He maintained the current distance and was re-evaluating the direction and sequence of this offensive, waiting for the next flaw to appear. At the same time, he was also looking for support points at the corners so that he could change his direction of movement if necessary.
Linghu Li didn't give him this time. He took two steps forward, raised the blade again, and the arc drawn by the sword's light briefly coincided with the edge of the light strip at the top of the corridor.
"Cangwu Tears of Bamboo Xiang Dao Jue" - [The tide rolls in the cave and the blade becomes cold]!
When the blade passed by, the temperature of the air dropped briefly along the path passed by the blade. The water vapor on the surface of the bulkhead condensed into an extremely thin layer of frost, covering the area crossed by the blade.
The man in gray robe turned sideways to avoid the trajectory of the knife, but the airflow caused by the remaining force of the blade still scraped the back of his hand holding the black blade.
There was a very shallow white mark left on the back of the hand. There was no bleeding, but the edge was slightly red.
Linghu Li stopped his strength.
But his sword power was not fully retracted after this swing. He turned back in advance when the blade was about to reach the end of its trajectory, and the blade swept back in the opposite direction, leaving a cross arc in the air.
"Cangwu Tears of Bamboo and Xiang Dao Jue" - [Thousands of bamboos shake their shadows and shatter the river wind]!
The sword light formed two superimposed arcs in the corridor, compressing the direction in which the gray-robed man could move to a smaller range.
The man in gray robe was forced to take a step back. The two blades crossed quickly in front of him, trying to find a gap to cut into at the intersection of the two sword lights. The blade collided with the blade three times in a row, and each contact left a new collision point on the blade.
The figure of the man in gray robe was knocked back a step after the third collision and hit the bulkhead behind him.
He still holds his double blades in his hands, but the holding position is two inches further back than before, and the stress point has exceeded the preset closing range.
His breathing became heavier, and the wound on his shoulder blade was still oozing blood, slowly flowing down along the edge of his robe, showing a gradual dark band in the warm yellow light of the lamp strip.
